invariants.rule: Spare Need belongs to exactly one Service Request and active demand aggregates by SR + BOM while contributor Device Part Units remain explicit.
Stock is a projection over eligible Spare Part Units; it is not a second physical identity and never auto-consumes or reserves stock solely because availability exists.
Every Spare Request references one-or-more Spare Needs from exactly one Service Request; draft, generated MSG and accepted submission are distinct states/actions.
Official SR7 and C10 values are business identifiers, never relational identities; correction preserves prior values as non-reusable history/aliases where governed.
RMA is an obligation identity with at most one direct inbound Spare Part Unit and at most one current return-unit obligation; no physical placeholder is fabricated before receipt.
Device Part Unit and Spare Part Unit remain distinct physical identities even when one replaces the other in maintenance.
Task allocation does not prove installation/use. Only an HLD-06 reviewed Task outcome plus accepted Inventory physical-consequence review may establish installed/removed/return relationships.
Inventory cannot create, rewrite, cancel, complete or retry Task/Objective lifecycle facts.
Submission-logistics snapshots are immutable requested-intent evidence and never prove actual dispatch, pickup, delivery, receipt or custody.
A Fault Tag submitted membership binds exactly one open RMA return obligation to exactly one eligible physical return unit; one obligation/unit cannot belong to multiple active submitted memberships.
Warehouse receipt does not close an RMA return obligation; only explicit final acceptance closes it. Rejection preserves history and keeps the obligation unresolved for later resend.
False-event correction, material submitted correction/replacement and genuine warehouse rejection/resend use distinct typed histories and never erase the prior accepted event/attempt.
Equal BOM, serial, SR7, C10, name or label can create reconciliation candidates but never authorize silent identity merge or reassignment.
Every supported Inventory transition has a manual path that does not require uploaded evidence; Beta 1.0 exposes no manual evidence attachment/upload UI.
Communication-derived facts are proposals until accepted through the owning Inventory command boundary.
Accepted Inventory history is append-oriented and correction targets exact events/relationships; hard deletion is restricted to genuinely untouched drafts under governing eligibility rules.
Bulk actions preflight every target, mutate only compatible reviewed scope atomically, and retain one independently addressable lifecycle event/result per affected target.
Local Spare Part Units without external provenance remain valid; later provenance adoption must not replace their immutable internal identity or prior history.

acceptance_hooks: multi-device same-BOM Need aggregation and cross-SR separation
local/external/mixed fulfillment without automatic Need consumption
MSG generation does not establish submission
partial RMA authorization and deterministic assignment/reassignment
Task-outcome correction causes Inventory supersession without Task-history rewrite
Fault Tag cross-request grouping with per-membership exclusivity
warehouse receipt vs acceptance vs rejection/resend
false submission correction vs replacement vs resend
manual parity with no evidence upload control
